title: Arrival push notification
journey: The driver writes a location, the arrivalAlert server function checks the geometry and the freshness, it pushes to the FCM topic ward_{wardId}, and the citizen's app receives the alert and opens the map.

steps.action: The driver writes vans/{vanId}.lastLocation on the GPS_INTERVAL_SEC cadence while the van is on shift.
steps.notes: The producer of the arrival signal; a direct Firestore write, not a callable.

steps.action: arrivalAlert fires on the vans/{vanId} update, gates on freshness (now - lastLocation.updatedAt <= STALE_LOCATION_SEC) and status == on_shift, reads the trip and route, walks routes.wardIds in order to find the next un-alerted ward.
steps.notes: Geometry: distance(van.lastLocation, ward.center) <= ward.radiusM + ARRIVAL_ALERT_RADIUS_M (100 m, CHG-0007 changed it from 500). Idempotency via trips.alertedWardIds inside a transaction.

steps.action: arrivalAlert sends an FCM push to topic ward_{wardId} (priority HIGH) and appends the ward to trips.alertedWardIds in the same transaction.
steps.notes: The topic is per ward so every citizen in that ward receives it.

steps.action: The citizen's app is subscribed to ward_{wardId}, receives the push, renders the notification, and tapping it opens the map (U1).
steps.notes: The ward topic is subscribed after bootstrapUserSession resolves the ward; the app never polls.

slices.evidence: lib/features/tracking/domain/tracking_engine.dart writes vans.lastLocation on a cadence via FirestoreVansRepository.updateLastLocation.
04-functions/src/triggers/arrivalAlert.ts is a real onWrite implementation with freshness, geometry (radiusM + ARRIVAL_ALERT_RADIUS_M), idempotency via alertedWardIds, and FCM push to ward_{wardId}.
slices.blockedBy: callables.json marks arrivalAlert lifecycle as planned; no client is wired to the ward_{wardId} topic yet, so the push is not delivered end to end.

slices.evidence: apps/citizen_app/src/App.tsx renders an arrival banner from VanSimulationEngine.onArrivalAlert and opens the map on tap.
slices.blockedBy: The user app uses simulation, not a real FCM subscription to ward_{wardId}. topics.json x-gaps: 'There is no inbound FCM handler' (no onMessage / onBackgroundMessage).

handoffs.notes: The driver's location write is the trigger for the arrivalAlert server function.
arrivalAlert pushes to the ward topic; every citizen subscribed to that ward receives it.

scenario.name: Arrival alert end-to-end
steps: The driver starts a shift and writes vans.lastLocation on the cadence.
As the van approaches the next un-alerted ward within radiusM + ARRIVAL_ALERT_RADIUS_M (100 m), arrivalAlert fires.
A push arrives on topic ward_{wardId} and the citizen's map opens on tap.
Only one push is sent per ward (alertedWardIds idempotency).

openQuestions: The user app's stack is React/Vite, not Flutter as the PRD states.
The user app's firebase project id is hardcoded to safai-saathi-panchmahal while the platform project is safaaisaathi-63a87; confirm which project the FCM subscription targets.
No client subscribes to ward_{wardId} yet; topics.json x-gaps records no inbound FCM handler. Decide whether to wire onMessage/onBackgroundMessage before marking this connected.
